title: Depth pass: Tangem and Exodus product lifecycle
notes: Existing entities/products only. Adds first-party product lifecycle milestones without changing current status fields or inferring unsupported availability dates.

events.title: Tangem Ring opened for public preorders
events.description: Tangem opened public preorders for the Tangem Ring on July 17, 2024 after unveiling the wearable hardware wallet at the 2023 Cardano Summit.
events.notes: This is a preorder milestone, not an asserted general-availability or shipping date. Tangem stated deliveries would begin later in 2024.

events.title: Tangem Mobile Wallet launched
events.description: Tangem introduced the Mobile Wallet as a free self-custody wallet available directly inside the Tangem app, with encrypted wallet keys stored in the smartphone security environment rather than a Tangem card or ring.

events.title: Exodus Web3 Wallet browser extension released
events.description: Exodus announced the release of its multi-chain browser extension, adding the Web3 Wallet product alongside its existing desktop and mobile applications.

evidence.title: What is the Tangem Ring?
evidence.notes: Primary Tangem source stating the Ring was unveiled at the 2023 Cardano Summit and became available for preorders on July 17, 2024.

evidence.title: What is the Tangem Mobile Wallet
evidence.notes: Primary launch source stating the Mobile Wallet was available that day in the latest Tangem app and describing smartphone-based key storage.

evidence.title: Exodus Announces Release of Browser Extension
evidence.notes: Primary Exodus investor-relations release announcing the multi-chain browser extension and its role alongside mobile and desktop.
